articles.title: 9 arrested for attack on police team in Siwan
articles.summary: Nine individuals have been arrested in Siwan following an attack on a police team. This incident, related to a law and order situation, underscores the challenges faced by local authorities in maintaining public safety and order within the region. The arrests are a step towards ensuring accountability for the assault.

articles.title: Calcutta High Court Refuses to Quash FIR Against CM Suvendu Adhikari, extends interim protection
articles.summary: The Calcutta High Court refused to quash an FIR against CM Suvendu Adhikari, a significant legal development. While denying the dismissal of the case, the court concurrently extended his interim protection, safeguarding him from immediate arrest. This ruling highlights the judiciary's role in ongoing legal proceedings involving prominent political figures and upholding due process in India.

articles.title: Sandia National Labs SA3000 8085 CPU
articles.summary: In the late 1970s and early 1980s, Sandia National Laboratory in the US initiated a major effort to develop comprehensive in-house capabilities for designing, fabricating, and testing Integrated Circuits (ICs) at scale. This strategic move aimed at establishing advanced expertise in critical semiconductor technology, crucial for national scientific research and potential defense applications, marking a significant period for the lab's technological independence.

articles.title: LOC España installs second BOBST press to expand label production
articles.summary: Spanish label manufacturer LOC España is expanding its production capabilities by installing a second BOBST MASTER M5 inline flexo press at its plant. This strategic acquisition aims to significantly increase output, building on a decade-long successful partnership with BOBST. The move highlights industrial growth and investment in advanced manufacturing technology within Spain.

articles.title: Why the Heart of India’s Indigenous Fighter Ecosystem Will be American for Several Decades to Come
articles.summary: India's self-reliant military modernization faces a major hurdle in jet engine technology. To address this critical gap, India is actively negotiating with U.S. manufacturer General Electric (GE) for its F414 jet engines. This initiative is crucial for bolstering India's indigenous defence capabilities and reducing dependency on foreign suppliers for advanced military hardware, aligning with strategic self-reliance goals.

articles.title: NEET UG paper leak case: Court extends Judicial custody of 10 accused till July 11
articles.summary: The Rouse Avenue court extended the judicial custody of 10 accused in the NEET UG Paper leak case until July 11. Produced via video conferencing, this ongoing legal action underscores the judiciary's firm stance against examination irregularities. Such developments are critical for upholding the integrity and fairness of national competitive exams like NEET, which are vital for countless student futures and maintaining meritocracy.
